purpose: Reference loss/augmentation/optimizer baseline for high-quality diverse priest adaptation
initial_update: Reuse the successful actual intended-configuration smoke update, preserving complete optimizer, PL, ADA and RNG state. Same trainer hash, recipe and threads; no repeat of the costly initial regularized update.
reference_components: Unmodified NVIDIA StyleGAN2Loss and AugmentPipe; separate main/regularization Adam phases, PL+R1, ADA100, EMA20, no FreezeD, paper256 loss/optimizer values. Single-device FP32 and gradient accumulation are recorded portability differences.
comparison: Compare against paused aligned110-frozen4 and ongoing CDC at matched kimg, not matched optimizer steps. Multi-component recipe comparison, not isolated causal attribution.
quality_gate: Inspect raw and EMA samples, fixed and unseen latents; verify adult male priest appearance, collar, no hats, realism and distinct identities. No promotion based only on losses or successful execution.
hardware: Local Apple M5 Pro MPS, concurrent CDC training. No rented compute.
